points.point: The company is involved in various legal proceedings including class actions for wage and hour violations and other labor, commercial, and regulatory claims.
points.quote: In the course of business, the Company is party to class or collective actions alleging violations of federal and state wage and hour and other labor statutes, representative claims under the California Private Attorneys’ General Act and various other lawsuits and regulatory proceedings from time to time including, among others, commercial, product, employee, customer, intellectual property, privacy and other claims.
